bootstrap.unit: sample twelve targets with replacement; average the three acquisition seeds within each sampled target before the cross-target mean

endpoints.certified_literal: number of scheduled candidates whose independently replayed exact equality verdict is true
endpoints.certified_ruleset_quotient: number of distinct player-preserving ruleset quotient strings among exact-equal candidates
endpoints.primary_effect: novelty minus equality certified ruleset quotients
endpoints.random_effect: novelty minus random certified ruleset quotients
endpoints.yield_ratio: novelty certified literals divided by equality certified literals
